subject: RFI: SIG questionnaire + SOC 2 control mapping (Helix Financial)
messages:
From: Jill Turner <jill.turner@helixfin.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.com
Cc: tom.li@helixfin.com
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire + SOC 2 control mapping (Helix Financial)

Hi Connor,

Thanks for taking the time on the call yesterday. As discussed, we've kicked off an RFI for our procurement/security review and attached the Helix SIG questionnaire (tabbed workbook). Our initial asks:

- A completed SIG questionnaire (where you can reference attestation artifacts or provide short answers).
- A mapping showing which controls align to your SOC 2 scope and any gaps.
- Proof artifacts we can review (policy docs, screenshots, short exportable logs or evidence pointers).

Can you confirm Redwood's intake plan and an expected delivery window? Our security team would like a first pass within 7 business days if possible.

Attachments: Helix_SIG_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Jill Turner
Director, Vendor Risk
Helix Financial
jill.turner@helixfin.com
From: connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Jill Turner <jill.turner@helixfin.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire + SOC 2 control mapping (Helix Financial)

Hi Jill — appreciate the workbook and clear asks. Looping in Karthik (security lead) and Neha (assurance) to own the control mapping and artifact pull. Marissa from CS will coordinate the mutual action plan and delivery cadence.

Proposed intake plan (high level):
1) Day 0 (today): confirm scope and required evidence types (we listed common artifacts below).
2) Day 1-3: internal owners populate the SIG workbook with references and link to artifacts.
3) Day 4-6: security validates mappings, captures any clarifying notes.
4) Day 7: deliver first-pass SIG + SOC2 crosswalk + artifact index.

Common artifacts we expect to provide: policies (info sec, access control), SOC 2 report summary and scope, encryption key rotation notes, MFA enrollment screenshots, sample audit logs export (redacted), architecture diagram, and third-party vendor attestations. If Helix needs original PDFs for SOC 2, we'll include the summary and offer an NDA-based full report exchange.

I'll create a shared Drive folder and a short mutual action plan doc. Karthik/Neha — priority on the SIG workbook mapping and a list of artifacts you need access to. Jill/Tom — any controls you want us to prioritize (data residency, encryption in transit at rest, or privileged access) let us know.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com

Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire + SOC 2 control mapping (Helix Financial)

Quick notes from the security side — thanks for the ping.

We should: 
- Mark controls that map to SOC 2 CC1-CC8 (where applicable) and call out unscoped items.
- Prepare a short "artifact types" matrix so Helix knows what to expect (PDF policies, signed SOC summary, redacted logs, screenshots, architecture diagram).
- Flag any items that require an executive attestation or are out-of-scope for the hosted offering (on-prem only features).

Action items for me: I will start mapping IAM, key management, network segmentation, and logging controls. Neha — can you pull the latest SOC2 summary and the control evidence index? Marissa — please draft the mutual action plan skeleton (owner, due date, delivery artifact).

-Karthik
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: jill.turner@helixfin.com, tom.li@helixfin.com
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 14:37:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: SIG questionnaire + SOC 2 control mapping (Helix Financial)

Hi Jill/Tom — attaching our initial deliverables and a short intake note.

Summary of what's included in the first pass:
- redwood_control_map_v3.xlsx: SIG workbook with control-by-control mapping to our SOC 2 scope and notes where evidence is queued.
- SOC2-scope-summary.pdf: high-level scope and testing period (note: full SOC 2 report can be shared under NDA).
- mutual_action_plan_v0.2.md: proposed ownership and delivery dates for outstanding evidence.

Highlights / clarifications: 
- We mapped ~82% of Helix's requested SIG control rows to scoped SOC 2 controls or existing artifacts. The remaining ~18% are largely organizational or process controls where we provide written narratives and sample artifacts (policies, screenshots).
- For PKI/key custody questions: Redwood holds customer KMS in the dedicated/private offering; for hosted we provide KMS abstraction and documented rotation processes. We called out the differences in the "Notes" column.
- Audit logs: included a redacted sample export and a link to the log retention policy. If you need longer retention for certain events, we can propose an opt-in retention addendum in the mutual action plan.

Next steps we recommend: 
1) Helix reviews the redwood_control_map_v3.xlsx and flags any controls that require additional depth.
2) We iterate on the mutual action plan; once agreed we will deliver the locked evidence bundle.

Attachments: redwood_control_map_v3.xlsx, SOC2-scope-summary.pdf, mutual_action_plan_v0.2.md

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Assurance Manager | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

- We highlighted ~12 controls where Helix may need a short call with our engineers for clarifying scope (network segmentation diagrams, KMS handling for cross-region keys). If helpful, Karthik can host a 30-minute technical RFI deep-dive next week.
- We included a proposed opt-in retention addendum in the mutual_action_plan_v0.2.md; Marissa can take the lead on commercial language (SLA/retention impact).
